recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore Goal.outcome under FHIR-5855 unless Patient Care makes a new final decision superseding FHIR-37262/FHIR-48360; Observation-side documentation should remain with its separate OO follow-up rather than this DSTU1 Goal outcome request.
issue_request: FHIR-5855 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care request to add an optional Goal outcome so closed goals could capture more detail than workflow status, approved as outcome 0..* with a CodeableConcept or Observation reference choice.
initial_application: The original key is not named in the implementation commit, but db4ace37c6615c9732f958d34d6286fe739fc657 is the March 2015 PC-approved change batch citing paired issue FHIR-5148 and it added Goal.outcome 0..* plus Goal.outcome.result[x] CodeableConcept | Reference(Observation). Later R5 source history converted the pattern to Goal.outcome as CodeableReference(Observation).
additional_context: Goal remains an active current-build resource, but current source intentionally has no active Goal.outcome. FHIR-37262 was Applied to remove Goal.outcome and use resource-pertainsToGoal instead, FHIR-53828 added the current Goal note pointing to that extension, and FHIR-48360 resolved a direct Goal/Observation link request as No Change because the existing extension can be used. The extension definition now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack with Resource context and Reference(Goal) value.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding Goal.outcome for this seed would reverse later final Patient Care decisions, while current Goal notes already describe the replacement outcome/progress linkage through resource-pertainsToGoal.
